title: Posturr: An open-source macOS app that watches your posture in real time with your webcam

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Your back hurts from coding for 12 hours straight. Someone finally built an app that won't let you slouch. Posture watches you through your webcam using Apple's Vision AI. And when you start hunching, it blurs your entire screen progressively until you can't see anything. Sit up straight. Boom. Crystal clear instantly. Uses your Max camera locally.
